staged_routing_schema.purpose: Represent composite Prompt Finder requests without collapsing the current agent, its output, and a later recipient into one behavior axis.

downstream_actor.condition: requested_output targets another agent or later stage

invariants: current_agent_disposition, requested_output, and downstream_disposition are separate axes
downstream fields are represented only when a downstream actor or later-stage artifact actually exists
explicit actor/stage boundaries supplied by the user are treated as resolved facts rather than re-asked preferences
the primary prompt owns the current agent's job, not the later recipient's eventual execution
follow-ons are dependency-ordered and limited to at most two
a plan or handoff being an artifact does not by itself make P56 primary
false binaries are invalid when their alternatives omit the user's already-stated desired state

cases.title: Interrupted local agent routes plan plus handoff without premature execution
cases.stimulus: Known repository; current assistant can inspect provider evidence but cannot inspect last night's local OpenCode residue. User wants an evidence-grounded preservation/convergence plan and a handoff so the local agent can discover local-only state and act.
positive_assertions: Select P04 because the current agent owns evidence-grounded factoring/planning.
Use P12 only after the plan exists to package the resolved state for the local recipient.
negative_assertions: Do not choose P06 or P07 merely because the downstream recipient may later mutate the repository.
Do not force the user to choose between execute-now and report-only alternatives.
prompt_markers: Known repository + inaccessible/interrupted local residue + inspect provider evidence + form a preservation/convergence plan + hand off to the local executor → P04 primary, P12 follow-on.
Do not route to a downstream execution prompt merely because the handoff recipient may eventually execute.
never reduce plan→handoff to “execute the repo work now” versus “only tell me what you found.”
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Pure repository reconciliation execution stays execution-bearing
cases.stimulus: Inspect the dirty local repository, preserve useful work, reconcile it, and merge when safe.
positive_assertions: Choose the cleanup/reconciliation execution owner because mutation is the current agent's job.
negative_assertions: Do not downgrade an explicit execution request into planning or handoff merely because those routes exist.
prompt_markers: Dirty local repository + preserve useful work + reconcile/clean/merge when safe → P06 primary.
CURRENT-AGENT DISPOSITION — what the agent answering now should do.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Pure handoff stays P12 when reasoning is already complete
cases.stimulus: The work is already complete and proven; compress the state for the next agent.
positive_assertions: Choose P12 because no material planning/reconciliation reasoning remains before packaging.
negative_assertions: Do not insert P04 when the planning job is already complete.
prompt_markers: Work is already complete + compress proven state for the next agent → P12 primary.
Do not route to a pure handoff prompt when meaningful planning/reconciliation reasoning must occur before the handoff can be safely written.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Plan-only repository convergence stays P04
cases.stimulus: Inspect the repository and decide how these branches should be reconciled, but do not execute.
positive_assertions: Choose P04 because current work ends at an evidence-grounded sprint/reconciliation plan.
negative_assertions: Do not promote safe executable follow-up work into current-agent execution when the user forbids execution.
prompt_markers: Inspect repository evidence and decide reconciliation order without executing it → P04 primary.
Select the prompt that owns the CURRENT agent's primary job.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Canonical tracked artifact generation stays P56
cases.stimulus: Recover our prior decisions and create or update the canonical tracked handoff document.
positive_assertions: Choose P56 when creation/update of the durable artifact itself is the useful job.
negative_assertions: Do not choose P04 merely because the artifact contains a plan.
prompt_markers: Recover prior decisions and create/update the canonical tracked handoff/document as the deliverable → P56 primary.
Do not route to P56 merely because a plan or handoff is an artifact; P56 is primary when artifact creation/update itself is the useful job.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Multi-stage sprint factoring then executor handoff keeps planning primary
cases.stimulus: Determine the sprint decomposition now, then produce an executor handoff.
positive_assertions: Keep P04 primary for the current factoring job and P12 as the packaging follow-on.
negative_assertions: Do not promote P07 to primary merely because the handoff recipient is an executor.
prompt_markers: Determine sprint decomposition now, then produce an executor handoff → planning owner primary; P12 packages the handoff; downstream executor behavior must not cause premature P07 routing.
DOWNSTREAM DISPOSITION — what the recipient of that output should later do
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: False execute-versus-report binary is explicitly rejected
cases.stimulus: The user already specified: analyze evidence, create a convergence plan, and hand that plan to a later executor.
positive_assertions: Treat the actor split as resolved from context and move to the next genuinely unresolved distinction.
negative_assertions: Never ask whether the current agent should execute now or only report findings when neither alternative matches the request.
prompt_markers: Actor/disposition boundaries are facts when the user has already specified them.
Do not force a false binary whose alternatives omit the user's stated desired state.
Explicit actor/stage boundaries are facts once the user states them.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static semantic regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

proof_ceiling: This matrix proves repository-owned static P65 semantics, staged-routing schema shape, route examples, and effective-prompt marker retention. It does not execute a language model interview or prove downstream model obedience, human preference, repository access, or runtime action success.
